title: Seasonal effect of PM2.5 exposure in patients with COPD: a multicentre panel study
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1244-1252
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00376D, Paper
Jin-Young Huh, Hajeong Kim, Shinhee Park, Seung Won Ra, Sung-Yoon Kang, Bock Hyun Jung, Mihye Kim, Sang Min Lee, Sang Pyo Lee, Dirga Kumar Lamichhane, Young-Jun Park, Seon-Jin Lee, Jae Seung Lee, Yeon-Mok Oh, Hwan-Cheol Kim, Sei Won Lee
Higher PM2.5 levels, particularly in winter, are associated with worsened COPD outcomes, including increased exacerbations and poorer SGRQ-C scores.
